source: Purposes from the tech spec (granular consent). Research ('ask only what is needed, and say why'): only clinician review is asked before the questions; the rest is asked on the result page, when it matters. GP sharing removed for the prototype (no GP connection); the database still accepts it if it returns. One-line explanations are DRAFT; the psychiatrist and the licensed provider approve the final text.

purposes.title: A clinician reviews my check-in
purposes.explanation: A licensed clinician reads your answers and chooses your next step. Without this, you still see your own results.

purposes.title: Check in again in about 4 weeks
purposes.explanation: A short check-in later, so you and your clinician can see how things change. You can stop at any time.

purposes.title: Help improve the service
purposes.explanation: Your answers, with nothing that identifies you, help us check the service works fairly for everyone.
